Thanks, Avery — appreciate the clear draft. Quick pass from our side with a few factual corrections and one redline:

1) The pilot timeframe in the doc says "June–August 2026"; our deployment window was actually July 12 — September 2, 2026. Please update the timeline.
2) The SLA number on page 2 references a 99.9% endpoint uptime — that was a target; our observed p95 latency figure is accurate, but please replace the uptime statement with "met performance targets during pilot" to avoid implying an SLA.
3) The ROI table underestimates model cost savings by ~12k — I've attached a corrected ROI-snapshot-table.xlsx with our numbers.
4) Quote: Jordan's suggested quote (short): "Redwood's serving runtime shaved our inference costs and made production performance predictable — a huge win for our engineering team." Please use that verbatim, but change "shaved" to "reduced" if Redwood prefers a slightly more formal tone.

Separately, Priya is looping Legal Ops on the attachment for a quick IP check — they asked for a PDF with tracked redlines.

We can sign off quickly after those tweaks.

Jordan
Director of ML Engineering
Stratify AI
